remarks: End unit in convenient Riverturn complex - light and bright. Hardwood floors in foyer, living room, dining room, kitchen, bedrooms and hallway. Living room with gas fireplace and sliders to deck. Eat in kitchen with granite counters and stainless appliances. Marble primary bath with whirlpool tub, separate stall shower and two sinks. Some california type closets. Loft or lower level family room could be used as third bedroom or REMOTE OFFICE. Skylites in master bedroom and loft. Two zone gas heat and central air conditioning. Walk to shopping center, Trader Joe's, Starbucks, banks and bus line. Close to Merritt Parkway and short drive to I95 and railroad station. Minimum credit score of 700 per owner!! ONLY ONE SMALL dog considered, NO CATS
